svg.title: RB2.1 — Product specs, v3, bound to BOM_v4
svg.desc: Product specifications tab bound to BOM v4.1: the passport describes the Bosch MS 50.4; the NX sheets supply dimensions and shaded views only.
svg.text: 1 · IDENTITY — the passport describes the Bosch product; the CAD is the AR mock
3 x AS018-35 connectors · 2 x 667 MHz dual-core · 8 GB flash
2 · MECHANICAL & ELECTRICAL — every mass and material read from BOM_v4.1
pinch a part, or pick from the list

g.text: BOARD MATERIALS · not discrete parts, no drawing

svg.text: 3 · CONNECTOR — 6 materials, straight from BOM_v4 By_Component
NX sheet · flange 43 long · bore 23,4 · 2 x 4 mounting
4 · PROCESSOR 1 — the CAD block carries the LCA active-component budget
NX sheet · 70 x 40 x 5 · 2 mm seat
5 · DRAWING ENLARGED — the tap target; dimensions become readable at 0.75 m
SOURCE OF TRUTH: every mass and material above is BOM_v4.1 / VCU_BOM_v4.xlsx By_Component. The NX sheets supply geometry and the shaded view only — no title, no label.
HOUSING SPLIT 108.5 / 235.5 g is not invented. BOM derives 344 g from 637 cm2 of shell area. For 166 x 121 x 41 the lid is 200.9 cm2 and the tray 436.2 cm2 —
they sum to 637.1 cm2, so the split is the BOM own geometry basis, not a new assumption.
PROCESSOR MAPPING (the one assumption): BOM rows 5-11 total 23.7 g across seven entries; the CAD has four blocks. Allocated by footprint —
P1 70x40 = 2x FCBGA + 2x flash 8.0 g · P2 50x30 = regulators + analog front-end 4.2 g
P3 60x40 = 6x power stage 9.0 g · P4 40x10 = transceivers + MEMS IMU 2.5 g. Sum 23.7 g — closes exactly against BOM rows 5-11.
SIZE: 166 x 121 x 41 mm is the Bosch data sheet. The CAD demonstrator is 200 x 150 x 60 and is never shown as the product size — it is the AR mock only.
CLOSURE: BOM_Data sums to 660.16 g against the 660 g data-sheet figure. Fine, but the 0.16 g should be stated in the thesis rather than rounded away silently.
